notes.title: Sclender 1.8.5
notes.notes:
- Sclender works better with various display settings and the Launcher window is larger
- Compatibility hacks for when you don't want to dig into an app's settings to get it to work with Sclender (beware the software rendering/reference rasterizer setting...)
- Tooltips (hints that appear when mouse moves over a widget) are a little easier to follow

notes.title: Sclender 1.8.4
notes.notes: Debug messages for GPU shaders are disabled by default (enable by clicking "Shader debugging enabled" on Config menu).

notes.title: Sclender 1.8.3
notes.notes:
- Full screen output automatically repositions the target application to the upper left corner of the screen
- Output positioning for offset mode fixed
- Dejag HQ filter has been improved

notes.title: Sclender Gamers Gold 1.8.1
notes.notes: This patch corrects the seam issues with TV CRT filter, and a couple other bug fixes.

notes.title: Sclender 1.8 Released
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]If multiple GPUs are installed/active they can be selected from the [b]Config Tab[/b]. By such means you can dedicate one GPU to Sclender and another to your game.
[*]You can now select how many processors/cores you use at a time for filtering. Look under the [b]Config Tab[/b].
[*]New filters released: ordered dither scaling, TV color filters and adjustments, vignette filter, posterization/bit depth reduction.
[/list]

notes.title: Sclender 1.7.4 (Gamer's Gold)
notes.notes: Sclender is now more streamer-friendly. Protocol is still to set Inactive Behavior to "Show", but the renderer no longer overlaps all other windows when in this mode, so you won't have to juggle it around your streaming software. If you still want the overlap behavior, set "Always top". "No filter" behaves like "Show", but like Hide, pauses filtering and releases most resources when not active..

notes.title: Sclender Lite 1.7 Update
notes.notes:

This update brings Sclender Lite in line with the developments in Gamer's Gold. Please report any issues/bugs/problems to either THE STEAM COMMUNITY FORUM ( https://steamcommunity.com/app/1855200 ) or the FACEBOOK PAGE accessible from the in-app "Support" button.

notes.title: Sclender 1.7.3 Update
notes.notes: Bug fixes; Sclender buttons now have more helpful tooltips.

notes.title: Sclender 1.7.2
notes.notes: Filters that expect fractions as parameters can now accept percentages or decimals. (ie 1/2 as ".5" or "50%")

notes.title: Sclender 1.7.1
notes.notes: This update fixes the crashing bug when Stretch (CPU) is not given a factor to stretch by. It also fixes seam issues when running with multiple cores. PC-98 style CRT (CPU) is also fixed.

notes.title: Sclender 1.7 Released
notes.notes:
It's a been a while since the last Sclender release. In that time a lot of work has been done.

[b]New filters[/b]: many new CRT filters; color adjustment filters and effects to mix together a faithful replica of the SD television/monitor experience. Bilinear and Bicubic filtering is now possible.

[b]Revisions to existing filters[/b]: CRT Scanlines now much more closely approximates the look of a television screen; other filters look closer to what their names suggest. CRT filters are easier on the eyes and clearer. The PC-98 monitor filter can now be fully edited to look like high detail CRT screens. The de-pixelizing "Dejag" filters now have adjustable characteristics.

[b]Improvements[/b]: Filters now support up to 4 input fields, each with a descriptive name. The Attach interface now displays a prompt telling you what to do after pressing the "Attach" button.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]:
-- the hanging thread bug is fixed
-- lots of other fixes

The known mouse input bugs are still outstanding, and it is still recommended to use means of capturing the mouse (either in-game or in a virtual machine app) to avoid them.

[b]Wiki Updates[/b]: in coming days the Sclender Wiki, available from the Support menu, will be updated to better showcase Sclender's features and filters.

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.6 Released
notes.notes: Some filters have been tweaked, and most CPU filters are faster. Tool tips have been added to the buttons to provide some extra instruction on how to use Sclender with other apps.

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.5 released
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]User can now manually override Sclender's title bar detection.[/b] This is important because bugs happen when Sclender thinks there is a title bar but there isn't one. To see these bugs for yourself, try Sclender with your browser's pop-out-video on Youtube or Twitch and compare with the override on vs off. (be sure to turn off the browser's hardware acceleration first! See wiki, under Support, for details.)

The override switch is located on the [b]Render Config[/b] panel, under "Capture".

[*] [b]Sclender will now use half of the cores on your system for CPU-based rendering[/b] (or 1 if there is only 1 core)
[*] [b]If Sclender fails to attach successfully to an app, the user will be notified[/b] (try it with the new Windows Calculator)
[/list]

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]

[h2]Bilinear post-filtering[/h2] makes irregularly scaled images look better

[h2]Bloom filter[/h2] is now multi-threaded

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] the rendering is a little cleaner
[*] Sclender is a bit faster
[/list]

notes.title: Sclender Lite 1.6.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added bilinear option
[*]BlurLeft and BlurLeftStrong fixed; algorithms for Perceptual Scanlines and Medium Blur changed. All known non-mouse related bugs fixed
[*] Sclender runs slightly faster
[/list]

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixes to rendering (checks window for title bar is presence, adjusts output accordingly)
[*]All buttons now show hand pointer instead of arrow pointer on hover
[*]Sclender Lite updates in-line with Gamers Gold edition (filter fixes and others)
[/list]

notes.title: AVX-2 Optimized!
notes.notes:
AVX-2 support is now implemented (for those systems which support it) for filters which have scan lines and for the "gamma" filters (Brighten, Darken). There may be further AVX-2 optimizations implemented in future.

Shine, a first-line filter for increasing the brightness of bright colors (similar to CRT characteristics) had a bug which made it awkward to use. It is now fixed.

The tutorial vid which runs on the Steam page has been uploaded to Youtube and is accessible from the Support button.

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.1 Released
notes.notes:
Some of you may have noticed that since some months ago a bug crept into Sclender which resulted in high resource use, latency, and lag... and crashes every half hour or so. In this version of Sclender those issues have been fixed.

These bugs trouble Sclender Lite also and will be patched soon.

notes.title: Sclender 1.6 released
notes.notes:
[b]Added GPU filters:[/b]
[list]
[*] PC98-style CRT
[*] S-Video-style CRT
[*] CRT Scanlines
[*] LCD
[*] GBA Scanlines
[*] Blur Left Strong
[/list]

[b]Fixed Dejag (GPU)[/b]


The GPU filters are substantially faster than the CPU filters and should perform well even on low-end machines. Enjoy!


[b]Focus for next version[/b]: Dejag family GPU filters

notes.title: Sclender Gamers Gold released
notes.notes:
The full version of Sclender provides better performance and more options than Sclender Lite, especially for streamers.

* Frame rates up to 144fps (depending on hardware capabilities) 
* Support for up to 4 cores for CPU-based filters
* The ability to position output at precise coordinates and to continue showing it when target apps are inactive
* Render manager enables oversight of all running filters and provides helpful information to interface your filters with streaming video apps
* Sclender auto-attach service begins filtering your apps as soon as you launch them

Sclender Gamers Gold retails for $24.99


All users of Sclender are invited to the Sclender Facebook group at https://www.facebook.com/Sclenderapp where you can get in-person support for using Sclender and developing filter projects, and we will also support you over the official Sclender Steam forum.
